scope: Three-file RoostNeedle material/shader delta, existing affected selector and exact two-row native command applicability only.
findings: World material factory establishes _materials[cliff] as ShaderMaterial with installed Rock030_Color/NormalGL maps and authored grey-green stone/strata/moss colors. duplicate() creates a separate ShaderMaterial parameter state, retaining those shader/map resources. Only the six RoostNeedle cylinder calls receive it; footing/collars/timber, other cliffs/crowns and original transforms/meshes/collision/camera/light are not changed by this binding.

Actual shader projection uses world_position.zy/xz/xy weighted by world normals, not cylinder UVs. Local texture_scale/normal_scale0.36 imply nominal2.7778m repeats, versus cliff albedo0.055 (18.1818m) and existing normal0.22. Frequency controls affect grain sampling, not positions or lighting.

New rock_texture_chroma float defaults1.0: mixing texture with itself at that endpoint preserves the previous texture RGB response mathematically. New rock_normal_strength defaults0.38: it replaces the identical original constant in normal mixing. Both shader consumers (cliff and surface include) retain defaults for all unmodified materials. No extra texture fetch, sampler path/filter or shared global setting changes.

Local chroma0 uses linear source-color texture luminance weights0.2126/0.7152/0.0722 replicated in RGB, preserving grain value while removing texture hue; authored stone/strata/moss palette still owns color. Local strength0.18 reduces mapped-normal influence in the existing normal mix. Numeric config values are finite and within the new0..1 uniform hints, with positive0.36 scales. Dictionary->float->set_shader_parameter and ShaderMaterial duplicate/cast are consistent with the existing factory types.

Needle-only config scope is cloudreach_client_presentation. There is no newly invented flag: local tuning is applied in its builder across presets. Existing global cloudreach_rock_candidate is still false in Low/Medium/High. If it is separately enabled, the preexisting courses/weathering branch can override albedo/normal frequencies and normal response; this proposal does not claim an ON witness or force-disable that branch.
